name: Jeremiah
overview: Jeremiah was a male leader from the tribe of Manasseh, identified specifically as a head of households within Manasseh. His role is noted in 1 Chronicles 5:24, highlighting his position of responsibility among his people. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeremiah means 'y-h-v-h loosens [the womb]; y-h-v-h lifts up; possibly y-h-v-h shoots, establishes,' reflecting a connection to the LORD (Yahweh). This meaning underscores a divine association inherent in his proper name as recorded in 1 Chronicles 5:24.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Jeremiah as a descendant of Manasseh, situating him within that tribal lineage as noted in 1 Chronicles 5:24. Beyond this tribal relationship, no other family connections are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Jeremiah's significance lies in his leadership role within the tribe of Manasseh, serving as a head of households, which indicates a measure of authority and responsibility. Though brief in detail, his mention situates him in the broader biblical narrative of Israel's tribal organization. His name's meaning further connects him to God's work among His people, reflecting themes of divine intervention and establishment.
